name: the simplest pattern
headline: The simplest *pattern*
sub: Overlooked, because it is so simple.
say: One pattern ties all of it together, and it is so simple that it was overlooked. A thing has a name. What it holds is named by its own signature. And anything it holds can hold more of the same. That is the whole of it. A picture, a page, a game, a whole community: each one is built from that one pattern, cell inside cell. Hypercomb does not ask you to study it. It shows it to you, in everything people make with it.
